title: Apothem Shared Profile
description: Canonical YAML profile consumed by Apothem before harness-native configuration is materialized.

schema_version.description: Optional profile-schema version. A profile without it is read as version 1 and migrated forward like any v1 profile; profile scaffolds always write it. A profile stamped with a version greater than the engine supports is rejected with an upgrade-the-engine diagnostic before validation.

harnesses.description: Per-harness overrides keyed by supported public harness id.

exclude_harnesses.description: Supported public harness ids skipped by batch lifecycle commands.

identity.description: Operator identity fields shared across harnesses.

role.description: Operator role presented to capable harnesses.

website.description: Operator personal or project website URL.

identityOverride.description: Optional identity fields overridden for one harness.

preferences.description: Workflow and interaction preferences shared across harnesses.

language.description: Primary programming language in lower-case semantic form.

rules.description: Additional rules shared with capable harnesses.

enforcement.description: Opt-in toggles for shipped behaviors that ship default-off; every flag defaults false and a clean install imposes none of them.

sprints.description: Opt in to the sprint apparatus for non-trivial multi-step work.

agent_teams.description: Opt in to parallel agent-team dispatch for parallelizable work.

multitasking.description: Opt in to parallel multi-task execution.

continuous_execution.description: Opt in to continuous multi-step advancement across natural boundaries.

learning_loop.description: Opt in to continuous-learning capture and pattern promotion.

workspace.description: Where Apothem keeps its shared, gitignored working directory (plans, memory, learning, contexts). One directory shared across every harness; never per-harness.

directory_name.description: Name of the shared working directory. A single path component (no separator, no drive specifier). Defaults to '.apothem'.

scope.description: Where the working directory is rooted. 'project-local' places <project-root>/<directory_name>/ (default); 'user-home' places ~/<directory_name>/.

harnessOverride.description: Canonical profile fields overridden for one harness.

mcpInventory.description: MCP server inventory keyed by server name: the canonical cross-harness portability surface for Model Context Protocol servers.

mcpServer.description: One MCP server. stdio servers carry command (+ args); http/sse/streamable-http servers carry url (and may carry headers for remote auth). Secret values in env/headers SHOULD be written as environment-variable references (${VAR}, e.g. ${GITHUB_TOKEN}); such a reference passes through to native config verbatim and is never resolved at render time, so no raw secret literal is materialized into a committable scope.

transport.description: MCP transport. streamable-http is the modern replacement for sse; bare sse is accepted for back-compat but deprecated and is never emitted as a default — prefer streamable-http for new remote servers.

command.description: Executable launched for a stdio server.

args.description: Arguments passed to the stdio command.

env.description: Environment variables passed to the server process. A secret value SHOULD be a ${VAR} reference (e.g. ${GITHUB_TOKEN}) rather than a raw literal; the reference passes through to native config verbatim and is never resolved at render time.

headers.description: HTTP request headers sent to a remote (http-family) MCP endpoint — the surface for Bearer / API-key auth (e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer ${API_TOKEN}"}). A secret value SHOULD be a ${VAR} reference rather than a raw literal; the reference passes through to native config verbatim and is never resolved at render time.

url.description: Endpoint URL for an http/sse/streamable-http server.
